Please refer to 31• How is bleaching povder manufactured? Give a neat labelled diagram and reactions involved.
Preparation: It is prepared by the action of Chlorine gas on dry slaked lime at a temperature Of about 400C.
Ca(OH)2 + C12 CaOC12 + H20 400 c Bleaching powder Slaked lime The temperature should be below 400C otherwise calcium chlorate and calcium chloride will be formed.

Bachmann's Plant: It of vertical iron tower with the hopper at the top, to feed lime and two at the bottom. One inlet is for the chlorine gas and other for hot air to be Introduced• It has two out lets, one at the bottom for bleaching powder to fall through it and the other near the top for the waste gases. The tower has about eight horizontal shelves fitted with rakes which push down the slaked lime.
